title: Prepared presentation, conormal charts and cleared relations for Popescu lifting
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let pi be an element of R, and let Cbar be a finitely presented R/pi^2R-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], compatible with its R-algebra structure. There are finite natural numbers n,m,r, polynomials f_l,a_k,h_{klj},g_{kl} in P=R[x_1,...,x_n], subsets E_k of {1,...,m}, and a surjective presentation map epsilon:(R/pi^2R)[x_1,...,x_n] to Cbar whose kernel is the ideal Ibar generated by the reduced f_l. Set C0=(R/pi^2R)[x]/Ibar. The elements epsilon(abar_k) cover every prime at which Cbar is smooth over R/pi^2R [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. For each k, (C0)_{abar_k} is smooth over R/pi^2R; |E_k|<=n; the classes of the reduced f_j for j in E_k give a basis of the localized conormal module Ibar/Ibar^2 [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]; and the differentials of (C0)_{abar_k} over R/pi^2R have a basis of cardinality n-|E_k|. In P one has a_k f_l=sum_{j in E_k} h_{klj}f_j+pi^2g_{kl} for all k,l. For l in E_k, h_{klj}=a_k delta_{lj} for every j and g_{kl}=0.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07CP, original DAG steps 1--4, preparation (1)--(4) (Tag 07CP; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP)

proof.text: Use Algebra.FinitePresentation.out and Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family for a finite polynomial presentation of Cbar over Rbar=R/(pi^2). Lift its finite relations along MvPolynomial.map_surjective of Ideal.Quotient.mk. The lifted reductions generate the kernel exactly.

Identify the reduced polynomial quotient with Cbar via quotientEquivAlgOfEq and quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective. Transport IsSmoothAtPrime through the induced localization algebra equivalence. Apply exists_smoothAtPrime_free_conormal_basis at each smooth prime; lift the chart polynomial and reindex its conormal basis from Fin(c) to the selected finset E.

Refine each initial chart by exists_popescu_cleared_conormal_chart. Its quotient value is a positive power of the old value, so it remains outside the original prime. This supplies exact unnormalized polynomial relations while preserving the bases and smoothness.

By FiniteType.isNoetherianRing applied over the Noetherian quotient Rbar, Cbar is Noetherian. Every subset of its prime spectrum is compact. Apply IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover to the principal opens of the refined charts and reindex the finite subcover using Finset.equivFin. This gives the finite chart family covering every smooth prime.

For l in E replace h_lj by a*delta_lj and g_l by zero; the finite sum is then a*f_l by simp. For l outside E keep the refined coefficients. Construct the PopescuLiftPresentation record and its Prepared proof with the lifted presentation, selected finite cover, preserved bases, exact relations, and these normalized coefficients.

theorem exists_popescu_lift_preparation (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] [IsNoetherianRing R] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [FinitePresentation (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar] :
    ∃ d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π, d.Prepared
